description: Figure 1 is a bar chart that illustrates the average performance and tokens of Chain of Unconscious Thought (CoUT) and baselines for four Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) across four benchmarks. The chart has two sets of bars, one representing CoUT and the other representing the baselines. Each set of bars is color-coded, with CoUT in blue and the baselines in orange. The bars are arranged in pairs, with each pair corresponding to a specific LRM and benchmark. The height of the bars indicates the average performance, with the y-axis labeled as "Average Performance" and the x-axis labeled as "LRMs and Benchmarks." The chart also includes a legend that explains the color coding of the bars. The values on the y-axis range from 0 to 1, with tick labels at 0.2 intervals. The chart is designed to compare the performance of CoUT with the baselines across different LRMs and benchmarks, providing a visual representation of the effectiveness of CoUT in improving the efficiency of Large Reasoning Models.
